quotes.text: It's been a while since we took our day trip, but there's not a week goes by that my 11-year old son doesn't talk about it. Between the seals, sea lions porpoises, an incredible close up with some transient orcas, and the incredible scenery, it was day to remember. Captain David is clearly a capable sailor, but he's also an excellent tour guide and a very friendly, genuine person. He made quite an impression on both me and my son (who's now enrolled in sailing lessons and is determined to captain his own boat on day!). All in all, a wonderful, memorable experience, I highly recommend!

In September of 2013 I had the most amazing time cruising the San Juans for three nights with David Howitt and All Aboard Sailing Charters. Really beautiful boat and David is the most friendly, capable and knowledgeable captain. Learned so much about the islands and their wildlife from him. We got to visit the Wooden Boat Festival in Port Townsend then cruise the northern islands in search of Orcas. David boat "Peniel" -is smooth and sturdy -would make a great base for a film project or perfect for a unique getaway. Can't wait to get back up there Magical journey through the San Juans

quotes.author: Sailing in the San Juans
quotes.text: I spent a wonderful afternoon last year on Captain David's sail boat. We saw orcas breaching, eagles, and seals. It was an absolutely amazing experience and I recommend this to everyone out there. I've been on several whale watching tours with different companies, but All Aboard Sailing is simply the best. Captain David makes each tour a unique experience, he is very knowledgable and truly cares about the people on board. You come as a guest, and leave as a friend. Sailing in the San Juans

We had a fantastic time sailing with Captain David. We've sailed with him three times, including one starlit evening cruise where we were surrounded by Orca whales! David took us ashore at Lime Kiln to hike and explore old kilns and to Yellow Island which was covered in wildflowers. David is a very knowledgable wildlife and natural history guide. The boat is beautiful and comfortable. This is a must-do activity when you are visiting the San Juan Islands. Wonderful Boat and Great Captain

Dave took our group out for a day of sailing in the beautiful San Juan Islands. He was so knowledgeable about the area and the wildlife, and we were treated with sightings of seals, sea lions, and killer whales. He knew exactly where to wait and watch these animals, and we even had a killer whale swim right under our boat! Will never forget such a memorable day on the water, thanks again for such a great trip! Best day on the water with Captain Dave!

quotes.author: Birthday sailing trip
quotes.text: It was a very relaxing trip on Captain David’s sail boat! There was plenty of room for our whole group. He was very accommodating to our needs and was available by phone when I had questions about the trip. The day turned out to be beautiful and we even got to see a whale! I highly recommend sailing with Captain David. Thank you so much for the wonderful experience! Birthday sailing trip
